title: The inflection point: why mobile gaming is becoming essential to the digital advertising mix
summary: The gap between audience scale and ad spend is closing. Learn why better measurement and addressability make mobile gaming an essential marketing investment.
body_markdown:
The gap between gaming's audience scale and non-endemic ad spend won't stay this wide for long. Programmatic teams that start building channel fluency now will be the ones setting the playbook once the rest of the market catches on.


As mobile gaming becomes a more essential part of the digital advertising mix, the industry's focus is shifting from proving the opportunity to strengthening the ecosystem around it. Initiatives like Unity Core Standards reflect that evolution, bringing greater transparency to mobile game advertising and helping build the confidence needed for broader adoption.
